text_blocks.snippet: Plants absorb carbon dioxide ( $\text{CO}_{2}$ during photosynthesis.

list.snippet: Absorption: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air through tiny pores in their leaves called stomata.
Ingredients: They combine this gas with water absorbed from the soil and energy from sunlight.
Conversion: Inside the plant cells, light energy converts these ingredients into glucose (sugar) for food.
Byproduct: The plant releases oxygen back into the air as a result of this reaction.
